name: gmsm-streaming-padding-and-block-cipher-b586
instr:
gmsm cannot stream padding, padded block modes, or CFCA SM4-CBC with bounded memory and declared lengths while preserving every padding scheme's wire format and interoperability with existing slice operations.

Extend every `Padding` from `github.com/emmansun/gmsm/padding`, including `NewPKCS7Padding`, `NewANSIX923Padding`, `NewISO9797M2Padding`, `NewISO9797M3Padding`, and `NewZeroPadding`, to report its exact encoded size without examining or allocating plaintext and reject negative or unrepresentable lengths.

Make `Writer`, `NewWriter`, `Writer.Write`, `Writer.Close`, and `NewReader` match `Pad`, `Unpad`, and `ConstantTimeUnpad` under any fragmentation, preserving Method 3 length framing and zero padding ambiguity. Writers must enforce the declared plaintext length, complete downstream short writes, latch closure or failure, and never repeat terminal padding or output. Writes after successful closure return `ErrClosed`. Readers must release only independently valid plaintext, preserve scheme-specific validation failures, expose the source's terminal condition after completion, and stop reading after a latched failure.

Make `NewPaddedWriter` and `NewPaddedReader` from `github.com/emmansun/gmsm/cipher` pass only complete blocks to block modes, reject block-size mismatches before output, and withhold terminal decrypted data until padding validation succeeds. Keep standalone ECB overlap behavior unchanged. Fragmented plaintext crossing padding finalization and ECB processing
